title: Pricing matrices opens sorted by name A to Z with an up arrow
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919), with the Settings - Parts permission.
  • Pricing matrix {Matrix-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PC36 alpha) exists.
  • Pricing matrix {Matrix-B} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PC36 Beta) exists.
  • Pricing matrix {Matrix-C} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PC36 rate 9) exists.
  • Pricing matrix {Matrix-D} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PC36 Rate 10) exists.
  • Pricing matrix {Matrix-E} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PC36 RATE 100) exists.
  • No other pricing matrix name starts with the same tag (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PC36).
  • You are on a page other than Pricing and the Pricing Search box is empty.
custom_steps:
1. Go to Settings and click Pricing in the Parts group of the Settings menu.
  2. Click the Pricing matrices tab.
  3. Move the mouse pointer away from the column headers.
  4. Look at the Matrix Category column header.
  5. Read the order of {Matrix-A}, {Matrix-B}, {Matrix-C}, {Matrix-D} and {Matrix-E} from top to bottom.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 4: the Matrix Category header shows an arrow pointing up (A to Z).
  • Step 5: the rows read {Matrix-A}, {Matrix-B}, {Matrix-C}, {Matrix-D}, {Matrix-E} (alpha, Beta, rate 9, Rate 10, RATE 100). Capitals make no difference and 9, 10, 100 are in counting order. The Matrix Category column shows the matrix names.
  • Step 5: the order is not character by character, which would read Beta, RATE 100, Rate 10, alpha, rate 9.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-11258; story SV-10135 (Story 2, Pricing Matrices, sortable column; story text re-synced to the PRD on 13 Oct 2026); PRD "Settings Pricing And Categories Sorting (Price/Category)", Confluence 578781186, version 21 (14 Oct 2026), S2-R1, S2-R2, S2-R3, S2-R4, read 14 Oct 2026; design canvas board 1.3 (Pricing matrices), 13 Oct copy, unchanged on 14 Oct. Tech plan Parts Settings Sorting (shared 13 Oct 2026), FR-013. Source-verified 14 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Price/Category QA build exists).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S2-R1: “The Matrix Category column header is sortable.”
  • S2-R2: “When the tab first opens, the list is sorted by matrix name in ascending order, A to Z.”
  • S2-R3: “The sort ignores whether letters are upper case or lower case, and compares numbers inside a name as numbers.”
  • S2-R4: “When the tab first opens, the Matrix Category column header shows an ascending arrow.”
  • Tech plan FR-013: “The Matrix Category header (which holds the matrix name) is sortable; the tab opens name ascending with an ascending arrow; clicking toggles; case-insensitive and numeric-aware.”
  • SV-10135 acceptance criteria: “Given matrices whose names differ only by case, then they sort together rather than every capital ahead of every lower-case name.”
